description: This file provides asynchronous repository functions for CRUD operations on MongoDB documents via Motor. It includes functions for inserting, finding (one or many), updating, and deleting documents, with handling for ObjectId conversions.

methods.name: ObjectId _to_object_id(id_str: str)
methods.description: Converts a string ID to a BSON ObjectId.

methods.name: str insert_one(collection: AsyncIOMotorCollection, document: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Inserts a document into a collection and returns its ID as string.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] find_one(collection: AsyncIOMotorCollection, query: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Finds a single document matching a query.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] find_many(collection: AsyncIOMotorCollection, query: Dict[str, Any], limit: int = 50, skip: int = 0)
methods.description: Finds multiple documents matching a query, with pagination support.

methods.name: bool update_one(collection: AsyncIOMotorCollection, id_str: str, updates: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates a document by ID with provided fields.
